content.gamesDescription: Glimmer remembers the games you join. They stay on this computer until you share them with a link code!
content.clearBody: Forget every game Glimmer collected? Games you joined before are not shared again unless you play them again.
content.shareDescription: Run /link create in our Discord, then paste the code here to find the games you and your friends have in common.
content.usernameHint: Shown to the others in the link.
content.needGames: Nothing to share yet. Join a game in Roblox and Glimmer will remember it.
content.needCode: Paste the link code from Discord to share.
content.needUsername: Enter your Roblox username to share.

shared.insertion: Shared your games as {{name}}. Run /link result in Discord.
